metadata.title: Public Health Analytics-OS unified registry object taxonomy
metadata.authorityBoundary: These are Analytics-OS discovery classes. They do not replace source-custodian classifications or make unlike objects semantically equivalent.

canonicalObjectTypes.definition: A source-specific or curated measure manifestation intended to quantify health status, determinants, inputs, processes, outputs, outcomes or performance.
A field or item captured by a form or information system; it may contribute to an indicator but is not automatically an indicator.
A source-published table, report, dashboard output or aggregate product whose computation may not be fully specified in the registry.
A constraint, consistency rule or quality check applied to reported fields or calculated measures.
A version-specific appearance of a measure field in a report schema. It is an occurrence, not a new canonical data element.
A report column used to identify, locate, stratify or interpret measure values, such as geography, facility, period or reporting unit.
An authoritative or evidentiary document, catalogue, portal page, dataset description or release artifact cited by a registry object.
A governed record of missing, inaccessible, outdated, conflicting or unresolved evidence and the action needed to resolve it.
A value for a defined indicator or data element at a stated geography, reporting unit, period and version. Reserved until governed aggregate datasets are ingested.

facets.programme: A health programme or programme family responsible for policy or delivery context.
facets.systemPortal: An information system, reporting platform or portal. HMIS belongs here rather than being treated as a health programme.
facets.sourceObjectType: The object label retained from the source representation.
facets.canonicalObjectType: The Analytics-OS discovery class assigned by this taxonomy.
facets.lifecycleStatus: The publication state of the Analytics-OS identity, separate from the source-version status.
facets.representation: A serialized appearance of one canonical object in a registry, catalogue, graph or interoperability artifact.

classificationRules: Preserve the source object label on every representation.
Classify an object as an Indicator only when the source or a documented Analytics-OS review treats it as a measure definition.
Do not promote a form field, output or validation rule to Indicator because it is analytically useful.
Do not treat a report-column occurrence as a new canonical data element when it resolves to an existing element.
Do not label metadata definitions as observed data points or values.
Keep candidate and unresolved records visible without silently promoting them to canonical status.
